description: Install openvox-agent from the Vox Pupuli repositories (apt/yum/dnf/zypper).

collection.description: OpenVox release collection to use (openvox8 or openvox9). Agents must not be newer than the server.

version.description: Specific openvox-agent package version to install (e.g. 8.25.0). Defaults to latest in the collection.

server.description: If set, write this as 'server' in the [main] section of puppet.conf.

proxy.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL used for downloads and package installs, e.g. http://proxy.example.com:3128 or http://user:pass@proxy:3128.

no_proxy.description: Comma-separated hosts to bypass the proxy for (sets no_proxy).

start_service.description: Enable and start the puppet service after installing.
